en.title: First Entry That Appears Only Once Among Full Logs
en.description:
Return the first full log line, in input order, that appears exactly once. Spaces are part of the log content; do not split into words or trim leading or trailing spaces. If there is no such line, output an empty line.

This site has made the standard input and output explicit; any range not given by the source is marked as this site's protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by exactly n log lines, which may be empty. 1≤n≤1000000. The source gives no string length bound; this site's input protocol is at most 1MiB per line, only printable ASCII characters and spaces, and at most 32MiB for the whole standard input; logs contain no newlines.
en.output: Output the full answer log followed by a newline; if there is no answer, output an empty line.
en.explanation: Example 1: A and B appear twice each and C once, so output C. Example 2: every log is repeated, so there is no result; output an empty line. Example 3: the full log a b is repeated, while a alone appears only once, so output a.
hints: First count the frequency of each full string, then find the first string with frequency 1 in the original order.
